contract_plain_english: In the scalar case m = 1, the constant matrix coefficient becomes a real scalar. [F1,F5] For a contaminant carried through a one-dimensional pipe by fluid moving at constant velocity ū, its scalar concentration or density q satisfies the advection equation q_t(x,t) + ū q_x(x,t) = 0. [F2,F3,F4] Subscripts denote partial derivatives, and the selected passage imposes no sign or nonzero condition on ū and supplies no initial data, boundary data, or formal regularity class. [F6,F7]
